name: B10-0277/2025 – § 8 – Am 9
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Clean Industrial Deal
part_text: 8.Calls on the Commission to take into account, in safeguarding both security of supply and affordability, all green technologies that contribute to reaching the EU’s climate neutrality goal for 2050 in a cost-effective way in the pursuit of a cleaner, stable, secure and more independent energy mix;
